summary: Replaced location picker modal with a dedicated /location screen. Restructured app navigation: root Stack layout with (tabs) group for Offers/Saved/Profile and a stack-pushed location screen. Tapping the location bar now navigates via router.push('/location'); selecting a location saves it and router.back() returns to Offers.
current_status: Location selection uses a full screen with back navigation instead of a bottom sheet modal. Tab navigation preserved under (tabs) group. Location persistence unchanged via LocationProvider.
